changes.detail: dispatch required `@absolutejs/telemetry ^0.2.0`, so an app that also used a package needing telemetry 0.3 (such as `@absolutejs/secrets` 0.9.7) installed two copies. telemetry 0.3.0 only added trace storage; dispatch now accepts any telemetry from 0.2.0 below 0.4.0, like queue, sync, rate-limit and audit-elysia.
